response.text: Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from a controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, if so, access to those personal data (including the right to receive a copy). It also entitles the data subject to information about the processing — for example, the purposes, categories of data, recipients, envisaged retention period, and the existence of rights such as rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and data portability. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))
